note: These roles currently operate locally on the study hub's existing notes. They are not connected to a hosted LLM. Do not put API secrets in GitHub Pages client-side code.

agents.name: Study Coach
agents.purpose: Choose a practical next study action and retrieval routine.

agents.name: Concept Explainer
agents.purpose: Retrieve matching course notes and provide a study scaffold grounded in those notes.

agents.name: Exam Setter
agents.purpose: Turn matching course notes into practice prompts and self-check criteria.

agents.name: Flashcard Maker
agents.purpose: Create a quick revision deck from existing question-and-answer cards.

agents.name: Revision Planner
agents.purpose: Build a time-boxed revision sprint around the learner's stated goal.

agents.name: Notes Navigator
agents.purpose: Search course headings, summaries, cards and notes, then link to relevant material.
